preamble.title: flightradar/markets
preamble.description: Parimutuel flight prediction markets: market state, CIP-68 position tokens, batched orders.

cardano/address/Address.title: Address
cardano/address/Address.description:
A Cardano `Address` typically holding one or two credential references.

 Note that legacy bootstrap addresses (a.k.a. 'Byron addresses') are
 completely excluded from Plutus contexts. Thus, from an on-chain
 perspective only exists addresses of type 00, 01, ..., 07 as detailed
 in [CIP-0019 :: Shelley Addresses](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/tree/master/CIP-0019/#shelley-addresses).

cardano/address/Credential.title: Credential
cardano/address/Credential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/PaymentCredential.title: PaymentCredential
cardano/address/PaymentCredential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/StakeCredential.title: StakeCredential
cardano/address/StakeCredential.description:
Represent a type of object that can be represented either inline (by hash)
 or via a reference (i.e. a pointer to an on-chain location).

 This is mainly use for capturing pointers to a stake credential
 registration certificate in the case of so-called pointer addresses.

cardano/transaction/OutputReference.title: OutputReference
cardano/transaction/OutputReference.description:
An `OutputReference` is a unique reference to an output on-chain. The `output_index`
 corresponds to the position in the output list of the transaction (identified by its id)
 that produced that output

flightradar/types/MarketDatum.title: MarketDatum
flightradar/types/MarketDatum.description: Inline datum of the market UTxO.

fields.title: market_id
fields.description: 27 bytes derived from the seed UTxO consumed at creation.

fields.title: question
fields.description:
What the market is about (flight, airport, threshold). Interpreted
 off-chain by the oracle and the UI; immutable on-chain.

fields.title: pools
fields.description: Lovelace staked per outcome. Its length is the number of outcomes.

fields.title: close_time
fields.description: POSIX milliseconds. Bets must be entirely before this instant.

fields.title: resolve_deadline
fields.description: POSIX milliseconds. An unresolved market can be voided by anyone after it.

fields.title: claim_deadline
fields.description:
POSIX milliseconds. After it the operator may close the market and
 sweep what is left (unclaimed winnings, rounding dust).

fields.title: fee_bps
fields.description: Fee in basis points, charged on the losing pools only.

fields.title: max_total
fields.description: Upper bound for the sum of all pools.

flightradar/types/MarketMintRedeemer.title: MarketMintRedeemer
flightradar/types/MarketMintRedeemer.description: Redeemer of the market minting policy.

anyOf.title: CreateMarket
anyOf.description:
Create a new market. `seed` must be spent by the transaction and
 determines the market id.

anyOf.title: MintOrBurn
anyOf.description: Mint position tokens for a bet, or burn any token of this policy.

flightradar/types/MarketSpendRedeemer.title: MarketSpendRedeemer
flightradar/types/MarketSpendRedeemer.description: Redeemer of the market spending validator.

anyOf.title: Bet
anyOf.description: Deposit lovelace and mint the same amount of position tokens.

anyOf.title: Resolve
anyOf.description: Oracle sets the outcome (or voids) and withdraws the fee.

anyOf.title: ForceVoid
anyOf.description: Anyone voids a market the oracle did not resolve in time.

anyOf.title: Claim
anyOf.description: Burn position tokens and withdraw their payout.

anyOf.title: Close
anyOf.description: Operator closes the market after the claim deadline.

anyOf.title: Resolved
anyOf.description:
Outcome is final. `None` voids the market: every position token
 redeems 1:1 for its stake.

flightradar/types/OrderDatum.title: OrderDatum
flightradar/types/OrderDatum.description: Inline datum of an order UTxO.

fields.title: owner
fields.description: Address that receives the result of the order.

fields.title: owner_key
fields.description: Key that may cancel the order at any time.

fields.title: batcher_fee
fields.description: Lovelace the batcher may keep for processing the order.

fields.title: deadline
fields.description: POSIX milliseconds. After it anyone may refund the order to its owner.

flightradar/types/OrderKind.title: OrderKind
flightradar/types/OrderKind.description: What an order asks the batcher to do.

anyOf.title: BetOrder
anyOf.description:
Stake `stake` lovelace on `outcome` and send the minted position
 tokens back to the owner.

anyOf.title: ClaimOrder
anyOf.description: Burn all position tokens held by the order and send the payout back.

anyOf.title: Fill
anyOf.description: Batcher executes the order against the market.

anyOf.title: Refund
anyOf.description: Anyone returns an expired order to its owner.
